subject.name: Saint Januarius, Bishop and Martyr
subject.subtitle: d. c. 305
subject.blurb: A bishop of Benevento martyred near Pozzuoli during the persecution of Diocletian, probably around 305. Naples honors him as its principal patron, and the cathedral preserves vials traditionally believed to contain his blood.
